instruction.text:
Jamie the Baker usually makes enough dough for 10 buns. Today he was able to make 3 more buns.
Select the matching addition.
How many buns did Jamie make?

Jamie then baked 17 loaves of bread. He sold 12 of them.
Select the matching subtraction.
How many loaves of bread is Jamie left with?

Jamie also makes cookies. Today he baked 9 cookies and his assistant baked another 6.
Fill in the missing numbers to complete the addition.
How many cookies did they bake altogether?

Finally, Jamie makes 18 cinnamon buns, but his brother eats 7 straight out the oven.
Fill in the missing numbers to complete the subtraction.
How many cinnamon buns is Jamie left with?
